title: Musk Says Hiring Jensen Huang Would Be an ‘Honor’
gist: Nvidia's board is reportedly weighing Jensen Huang's future after reports of extramarital affairs, including an alleged relationship with a direct report and scrutiny of ties to a former Megaspeed executive linked by reports to Chinese intelligence; Elon Musk said hiring Huang would be an 'honor', raising governance and succession questions at the center of the AI industry.

insights.claim: The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's board was preparing to consider removing CEO Jensen Huang following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, with other reports describing efforts to explore possible successors.
